rules.expected: Candidate-level frequency and connectivity validation supports the named public-diethyl events and each selector identifies its candidate; audit-only SI structures are labelled separately.
The 28.3/34.3 values are disclosed as source-reported audit values with the dimethyl/diethyl and convention conflict; no unconditional numerical score is applied.
A validated public-diethyl prompt-loss barrier is reported, or a bounded failure identifies the missing saddle/IRC evidence; source 28.3 is not used as an unconditional target.
A validated public-diethyl retained-N2 barrier is reported, or a bounded failure identifies the missing saddle/IRC evidence; source 34.3 is not used as an unconditional target.
Prompt N2 loss is concluded lower only after both public-diethyl events are validated on a common convention, with explicit source-audit limitations.
